notes:
## New features & enhancements

- The preset keys now fade a long station name at its edges as it scrolls, the same way the readout above them does. They were still cutting theirs against a hard line, which showed as a join on the painted faces.
- A key whose name is only a little too long is left alone and keeps its ellipsis, which says there is more to see better than a fade does. The fade appears only while a name is actually moving: when you hover a key, or for the station that is playing.
- Both the readout and the keys now take their two edge widths from one shared pair, so the two can no longer drift apart.

## Bug fixes

- The segment, split-flap and 8-bit faces are properly left out of the feathering on their preset keys. Those displays are made of cells, which are lit or not, so a soft edge is wrong for them; the rule meant to exempt them was being outweighed and had no effect.
- Enhancements and fixes in seasonal themes.
